group_key_rule: sequence prefix before underscore; conservative leakage group, not proven participant identity
training_rule: Fit normalization and circular ridge readout on 50 Hz rows only; evaluate identical weights and 10 Hz recurrence at 50 and 100 Hz. Reset state per full sequence/segment and split by subject prefix before window extraction.
lock_rules: No validation member may be fetched or opened before implementation, tests, complete development output, selected config, fitted-weight hash, and implementation hashes are committed.
No window or recurrent state from a held-out cross-validation sequence may enter normalization, fitting, or selection for that fold.
Validation cannot change implementation, fields, state update, target, grid, normalization, metrics, thresholds, alignment, or missing-output handling.
Weights remain ignored and non-shippable under the RoNIN non-commercial research license.
No result from this split is a product or Android lifecycle Go.
